card.name: Overdose management opening phrases
card.fires_on: The word "adequate" after "ensure", and the comma after "In case of overdose" or "overdosage", in overdose-treatment sections. Also a comma in a list of effectiveness ratings.

modes.label: Comma after overdose clause
modes.description: The comma that ends "In case of overdose" before the treatment steps begin.
modes.example: Treatment of Overdose Oxycodone In case of overdose<<,>>

modes.label: Adequate after ensure
modes.description: The word "adequate" in "ensure adequate oxygenation and ventilation" in airway-management advice.
modes.example: In case of acute overdosage, establish and maintain an airway and ensure<< adequate>> oxygenation and ventilation.

modes.label: Rating scale comma
modes.description: A comma after "Effective" in a list of effectiveness ratings.
modes.example: according to the following scale: Effective<<,>> Likely Effective, Possibly Effective
